distribution.narrative: Johnson et al. (2023) documented Chinese specimens from Yunnan, and placed the genus Urocorthylus in Dryocoetini. The China-associated host observations are distinct from Thailand-only Lithocarpus material.

host_note: China-associated host names as reported for Yunnan specimens. Lithocarpus sp. records from Thailand in Johnson et al. (2023) are not attributed to Chinese occurrences.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Urocorthylus hirtellus Petrov, Mandelshtam & Beaver, 2007. Original authorship Petrov, Mandelshtam & Beaver, 2007; later Yunnan evidence and Dryocoetini placement in Johnson et al. (2023).

taxonomic_history.name: Urocorthylus hirtellus
taxonomic_history.note: Original authorship Petrov, Mandelshtam & Beaver, 2007; later Yunnan evidence and Dryocoetini placement in Johnson et al. (2023).

nomenclature_note: Recommended Chinese name: 密毛小蠹 (newly proposed in the 2026 China checklist; curator-approved).
